name: induced-failure-checks-share-the-scan-fixture
body: The induced runCli and runInProject failure assertions run inside the boundary e2e's scanned-project scenario, so they are skipped unless APG_SUITE_E2E=1 and share its apg init, scan and project start fixture; upgrade by extracting a lighter fixture if that setup moves or if the failure text must be pinned in the default tier.
